title: #259 Hurry or Slow-paced
prompt: Some people are always in a hurry to get somewhere and get things done. Others prefer to take their time and live a slow-paced life. Will you prefer the slow-paced life and why？

promptSegments.text: Some people are always in a hurry to get somewhere and get things done.
Others prefer to take their time and live a slow-paced life.
Will you prefer the slow-paced life and why？

hardVocabulary.enGloss: A key word in this prompt.
A key word in this prompt.

requirements.en: Answer every direct question in the prompt.
requirements.vi: Trả lời mọi câu hỏi trực tiếp trong đề.

requirements.en: State a clear and consistent position when an opinion is requested.
requirements.vi: Nêu quan điểm rõ ràng và nhất quán khi đề yêu cầu ý kiến.

requirements.en: Develop each main idea with explanation and an example.
requirements.vi: Phát triển mỗi ý chính bằng giải thích và ví dụ.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: A slow-paced life allows people more time for enjoyable daily activities, leading to reduced stress and increased happiness.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: A slow-paced life allows people more time for enjoyable daily activities, leading to reduced stress and increased happiness.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Slow living facilitates stronger connections with family and friends because people are not constantly rushing.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Slow living facilitates stronger connections with family and friends because people are not constantly rushing.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first main point is that a slow-paced lifestyle helps people improve their mental health by allowing them to enjoy their daily activities.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first main point is that a slow-paced lifestyle helps people improve their mental health by allowing them to enjoy their daily activities.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The second main point is that a slow pace helps people build stronger relationships by giving them time for deep connection with others.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The second main point is that a slow pace helps people build stronger relationships by giving them time for deep connection with others.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The primary advantage of a slow-paced life is its positive impact on mental and physical health, promoting a sense of well-being.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The primary advantage of a slow-paced life is its positive impact on mental and physical health, promoting a sense of well-being.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Another benefit of adopting a slower pace is the opportunity for deep personal reflection, which aids in self-discovery and goal setting.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Another benefit of adopting a slower pace is the opportunity for deep personal reflection, which aids in self-discovery and goal setting.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not ignore a direct question in the prompt.
promptTraps.vi: Không bỏ qua câu hỏi trực tiếp trong đề.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionEn: How many main ideas should I use?
faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh câu chung học thuộc và mọi ý không trả lời đúng yêu cầu.
